evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
Game Type: 5x3 Video Slot
Paylines: 10 - fixed
RTP (%): 96,17 %
Max win; x Bet: 1 200 / 120 000
Bonus Features: Re-spin and 2x/3x win multipliers
Special Symbols: Expanding, sticky wild
Volatility (variance): Low
Game URL: "https://starspell.slotmill.com"
StarSpell is a 5-reel video slot with 10 bet lines where you can win two-ways – left to right or right to left on each bet line. Expanding Wilds appear on reels 2, 3 and 4 triggering a free re-spin. The wilds are sticky during the re-spin and additional wilds trigger another re-spin. A 2x win multiplier is applied to wins if two wilds are present and a 3x multiplier is applied to wins if three wilds are present. All 10 bet lines are always active, and players simply set their desired bet per spin in the casino currency. StarSpell is a low volatile game with a maximum win of 1,200 times bet or 120,000 Euro at max bet. The default bet levels can be customized for each operator.
